title: HLSE Package Verdict
description: JSON output of `hlse_core --json package <name> [<ecosystem>]` — supply-chain security check for typosquat and dependency-confusion attacks.

hlse_version.description: HLSE engine version that produced this verdict.

name.description: Legitimate package name that the input resembles.

distance.description: Edit distance (Damerau-Levenshtein) from input to legitimate name.

matches.description: Legitimate packages the input may be masquerading as (score > 0 only).

ecosystem.description: Package ecosystem (pip|npm|cargo|go|gem). Present in `package --manifest` output entries.

signal_count.description: Number of similar packages found (score > 0 only).

pattern_id.description: Stable SIEM/SOAR routing token (present iff pattern is present).

objective.description: The attacker's likely objective (score >= 40 — ALERT band and above).

verify.description: Independent check before installing (score >= 40 — ALERT band and above).

triage.description: Immediate response if already installed (score >= 60 only).

cascade_risk.description: Other credentials and packages at risk (score >= 60 only).
